title: PILLAGER BOTS: RED COATS, GOLD BODY, NOTICE TELL, FALL
why: His art survey picks: every hostile pillager bot wears the same dark red coat with the angry brows and shows its role through gear only (hires keep their own colours); the golden enemy has a solid gold body with a shine sweeping across it; a bot that notices you keeps the red mark and also hops, flares red eyes and tightens its brows for 0.45 s; a bot that dies tips over flat as itself and fades. Drawing only: no random draw and nothing the sim reads.
now: Enemy pillager bots all wear dark red, the golden one is solid gold with a shine, bots hop and flare red eyes when they spot you, and they fall over flat when they die.
